task.title: Create first class RiskPolicy evaluator contract
task.summary_zh: 把 risk_policy_ref 升級為可執行的統一風控 evaluator contract，讓 optimizer、promotion、deployment、runtime manager 都能用同一套風控判斷。
task.phase: EPIC MPOS / P1 governance risk and artifact integration
acceptance: RiskPolicy evaluator exposes limits for exposure asset class liquidity drawdown canary scale and kill switch triggers
Optimizer hard veto uses the evaluator or an adapter with equivalent contract
Promotion and deployment reject policy violations before runtime binding
Runtime manager can verify pool risk policy identity and stage scoped limits
Tests prove risk veto outranks committee aggregator and persona suggestion
